sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.
Rejected. No temporary source for BR-220 without 6082-T6 capability and a closed 8D.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) has conditional qualification, so it cannot receive new parts now. The only evidence is the 2026-10-02 minutes. Nothing in the documents shows the status has changed since.

sources.quote: Approved blank source: Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B), single source.

findings.why: The controlled part card for BR-220 (Aurelia, PRG-X) names SUP-B as the only approved blank source. SUP-C has no approval for this part. DEV-127, the temporary-source request, was rejected.

sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6. Not interchangeable with EN AW-6061: different alloy, lower yield.
Special characteristic SC-BR220-YS: yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa
Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.
Meccanica Chisone told me on the phone they can make BR-220 blanks from the same alloy they use for BR-310

findings.why: The drawing in force requires 6082-T6. Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5, so it does not show capability against SC-BR220-YS. The claim that it is the same alloy rests on a phone call, not a controlled record. Even if the alloy matched, the temper would still differ.

findings.key: 8D on cracking, Chisone 6082 material (id not in documents)

sources.quote: the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on cracking in its 6082 material, which is the alloy of BR-220. The 8D number is not in the documents, so the key is a description. The statement is from 2026-10-02, so a person should confirm the 8D is still open. 8D-25-019 is closed and belongs to SUP-B, so it does not apply.
